description: Returns a temporary signed PDF download URL for a specific Paddle invoice/transaction. Use when the user asks 'download my invoice', 'get the receipt for transaction X', 'give me the PDF for invoice Y'. Requires a transaction_id — use get_outstanding_balance or list_invoices to find transaction IDs. OwnerAdmin or Admin only. URL expires after a short period.

transaction_id.description: Paddle transaction ID to fetch the PDF for. Required.

name: get_invoice_receipt
title: Invoice Receipt PDF
